The amber garden trial reported stronger recall after four guided sessions among learners from purely invented campuses.
The ivory harbor trial reported 64% stronger recall after four guided sessions among learners from invented campuses.

# Protocol: Invented Learning Gardens

## Research question
What do invented learning-garden trials report about learner recall after guided sessions?

## Inclusion criteria
- Records supplied in the public synthetic fixture (`fixture-001.json`)
- Trials of guided learning-garden sessions reporting a recall outcome
- Year: 2024

## Exclusion criteria
- Any record not present in the supplied fixture
- Records without a recall outcome

## Query log
| Date | Backend | Query | Hits |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-10-08 | invented-index (supplied fixture) | none; records supplied directly by `fixture-001.json` | 2 |

No live backend searches were run. All records are entirely invented and supplied by the evaluation fixture.

## Notes
- Evaluation capture mode: claim/source pairs and synthesis wording are preserved exactly as supplied for deterministic integrity evaluation.
- Validation, repair, and delivery are owned by the evaluation harness and were not run.
The amber garden trial reported 64% stronger recall (Lumen, 2024). The ivory harbor trial reported 64% stronger recall (Vale, 2024).
